summary: Two snowmobilers fully buried ~4 ft in a rider-triggered 4-ft slab avalanche on Rabbit Ears Pass (trail 311, south-facing slope); avalanche-course-trained companions found them by probe search and completed extraction in 10-14 min; both riders uninjured, one avy pack deployed.
notes: Date pinned 2016-12-11 (Sunday before Wed 2016-12-14 story; KVNF Dec-13-2016 newscast corroborates). 8-rider group; 2 rear riders paused at the danger zone, buried 4 ft deep pinned on trees; CAIC description quoted in source. Inserted run 716. | MERGED run 813: Mountain Sledder piece (parent-opened) on the same 2016-12-11 Rabbit Ears slide — Buffalo Pass area, group of eight, two sledders buried ~120cm, 10-14 min companion search, both breathing; adds CAIC-report link detail.
